Product Disclaimer: Product packaging may vary.
The legend himself! Classic Magic illustrator Dan Frazier defined “old school cool” with his work on the original Moxen and beyond. He even returned recently to grace Secret Lair with enemy-color signet cards. This time, Dan’s turned back the clock on five enemy-color talismans and we couldn’t be more thrilled with the results—especially seeing them retro-fitted with Retro frames!

Contents:
• 1x Foil Etched Retro Frame Talisman of Hierarchy
• 1x Foil Etched Retro Frame Talisman of Creativity
• 1x Foil Etched Retro Frame Talisman of Resilience
• 1x Foil Etched Retro Frame Talisman of Conviction
• 1x Foil Etched Retro Frame Talisman of Curiosity
